sql_query.query: UPDATE _care_task SET title = COALESCE($1, title), description = COALESCE($2, description), priority = COALESCE($3, priority), status = COALESCE($4, status), completedAt = CASE WHEN $5 = 'COMPLETED' THEN $6 ELSE completedAt END, dueDate = COALESCE($7, dueDate), category = COALESCE($8, category), assignedToId = COALESCE($9, assignedToId), updatedAt = $10 WHERE id = $11 AND careRecipientId IN (SELECT id FROM _care_recipient WHERE primaryCaregiverId = $12)
